notes:
JARVIS v0.5.3

今次更新讓 JARVIS 更像一位真正的助理：說話更自然，可以一直聆聽「Hey Jarvis」，並可按你的喜好調整回覆方式。

一直聆聽
- 工作總覽新增「一直聆聽」開關。開啟後，先說「Hey Jarvis」再說出指示即可，毋須按鍵；關閉前會一直聆聽，重新開啟 App 後亦會保持。
- 喚醒詞由此 Mac 上的語音模型辨識，說出喚醒詞之前，聲音不會離開此 Mac。首次開啟會下載約 148 MB 的語音模型。
- 喚醒詞改以英文辨識，語音辨識語言設為廣東話時亦能喚醒。
- 喚醒後的指示最長可說 28 秒，停頓約 1.5 秒才會結束，句子中途稍停不會被截斷；在嘈雜的環境中亦不會每次錄滿 28 秒。
- 大幅降低聆聽時的 CPU 用量；JARVIS 朗讀回覆時不會再聆聽自己的聲音。

更自然的回覆
- JARVIS 會先給答案，再主動提醒下一步，例如撞期或待回覆的郵件，不再每句以你的名稱開頭。
- 找不到資料時，會換關鍵字、放寬日期或查看其他來源再找。
- 處理期間會顯示正在做甚麼，例如「搜尋郵件：Gold Badge」；回覆下方可展開「處理過程」，查看今次查過的來源。
- 以中文回覆時，朗讀的過渡句亦會使用中文。

個人化
- 「設定 → AI 助理 → 個人化」可設定 JARVIS 對你的稱呼、語氣、回覆長度、中文回覆（書面語或自然廣東話）、搜尋深度，以及其他回覆偏好。寫給其他人的郵件、活動及筆記一律使用書面語。

對話
- 側邊欄「最近工作」列出所有已儲存的對話，包括在頂部「AI 助理」開始的對話。
- 可從側邊欄刪除對話，對話內容會從此 Mac 刪除；已建立的郵件草稿或活動會保留。
- 從頂部「AI 助理」開始的對話會自成一段，不再加入語音對話。

適用於 Apple Silicon Mac，App 要求 macOS 12 或以上。
notes_en:
JARVIS v0.5.3

This update makes JARVIS feel more like a real assistant: it talks more naturally, can keep listening for "Hey Jarvis", and lets you choose how it replies.

Always listening
- The Automation overview has a new Always listening switch. Say "Hey Jarvis", then your request, with no key to press. It keeps listening until you switch it off, including after you restart the app.
- The wake phrase is recognised by a speech model on this Mac, so nothing you say leaves the Mac until you say it. Switching it on the first time downloads a speech model of about 148 MB.
- The wake phrase is now recognised in English, so it also works when speech recognition is set to Cantonese.
- After the wake phrase you can talk for up to 28 seconds, and a pause of about 1.5 seconds ends the request, so a short pause mid-sentence no longer cuts you off. In a noisy room it no longer records the full 28 seconds every time.
- Listening uses far less CPU, and JARVIS no longer listens to itself while it reads a reply aloud.

More natural replies
- JARVIS leads with the answer, then points out what to do next, such as a clash or an email you owe, and no longer starts every reply with your name.
- When a search finds nothing, it tries other keywords, a wider date range or another source.
- While it works, it shows what it is doing, for example "Searching emails: Gold Badge". Under a reply you can open What I did to see the sources it checked.
- When it replies in Chinese, the lines it reads aloud while working are in Chinese too.

Personalisation
- Settings → Assistant → Personalisation lets you choose what JARVIS calls you, its tone, reply length, Chinese replies (written Chinese or natural Cantonese), search depth, and anything else about how you like replies. Emails, events and notes written for other people always use written Chinese.

Conversations
- Recent tasks in the sidebar lists every saved conversation, including ones you start from Assistant at the top.
- You can delete a conversation from the sidebar. Its messages are removed from this Mac; drafts or events it created are kept.
- A conversation started from Assistant at the top is now its own conversation instead of joining the voice conversation.

For Apple Silicon Macs; the app requires macOS 12 or later.
